name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.5.8
summary: Release v1.5.8: Hardened setup wizard lockout, defense-in-depth re-initialization blocking, locked banner protection, and auto-redirect guards.
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.5.8:
* **Setup Wizard Lockout:** Default-hidden wizard interface and locked banner to prevent unauthorized users from viewing or triggering setup on operational appliances.
* **Defense-in-Depth Provisioning Rejection:** Enforced multi-layered 403 Forbidden rejection on POST /api/v1/setup/provision if Samba AD DC is configured or appliance is locked.
* **Client Navigation Redirection:** Added proactive client-side redirection in core.js and setup.js routing visitors of setup.html directly to index.html (when authenticated) or login.html.
